name: Foundry: Hammer and Pour
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: HAMMER AND POUR — THE FOUNDRY circuit's rotor+debris pair (tier 2; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 11). Two different lethal families run on the validated flagship three-island / one-void shape: a SPINNING HAMMER sweeps island B and molten FALLING DEBRIS rains on island C, so the traverse escalates left-to-right — spawn safe on A, FLY B timing the blade, FLY C reading the droplet shadows. Each hazard was validated solo (foundry_single_hammer / foundry_droplets); this is the tier-2 pair. Island A is a permanent hazard-free refuge.

DOCTRINE FIT: (A) HAMMER over B (hub x2030): slow ~4.5s rotation, arc_deg 150 (<360 so a ~1.08s clear window returns at each apex), LETHAL head via kill(&ring_out); bottom-of-swing sits ~y1070 over B's center, apexes rise HIGH over the gaps (safe crossing altitude); B's edges sit below the arc. (B) DEBRIS over C (columns x3385/3835): cadence 1.5s, max_concurrent 1, telegraph_lead 0.7s ground shadow; C's edges + mid-column band always safe. FAIRNESS (both): island A is a permanent refuge; neither hazard covers 100% of its island; the crossings between islands are never blocked; symmetric; no player spawns under the blade or a live column. CREDIT (both): a hazard kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival knocked into the blade / under a droplet within the 6.0s ring-out window is credited; no environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (flagship void_is_floor): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 (REFUGE/spawns) / B x1580..2480 (HAMMER, hub x2030) / C x3160..4060 (DEBRIS), all top y1080, separated by 680px void gaps. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 610px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the hammer on B (apex-dwell beat / hug an edge below the arc); DODGE the debris on C (step off a marked column in its 0.7s telegraph). Neither makes a required gap crossing uncrossable (the blade arc over the gaps is HIGH; the debris falls on C's top). Verb: DODGE (+ TIME/READ).
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the hazards reshape/time the on-island fight.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the Foundry's rotor+debris combo (foundry_smelter is crusher+hammer; foundry_inferno stacks three). SPAWN NOTE: primaries on the hazard-free island A plus one edge each on B (x1650, left of the blade's center reach) and C (x3220, left of the debris columns); QA to confirm the B/C edge starts sit clear at combat start (hammer phase 0.0 parks the blade high; debris start_delay 0.7). One-line read: 'time the swing on the middle deck, read the molten rain on the right, and shove rivals into either.'
